summary: Index-based selector over two global DWORDs: returns the value of dword_5BF8CC when a1 is 0, the value of dword_5BF8D4 when a1 is 1, and -1 for any other index. No state is modified.

local_names.a1: selector index (0 selects dword_5BF8CC, 1 selects dword_5BF8D4)

operations.description: If a1 is zero, return the current value of global dword_5BF8CC.
If a1 equals 1, return the current value of global dword_5BF8D4.
For any a1 other than 0 or 1, return the default value -1.

unresolved: The meaning of the two selected globals (dword_5BF8CC, dword_5BF8D4) and of the selector index a1 is unknown; caller semantics (SeasonSpecificTeamIDLookup, MapCollisionShapeToBoneIndex, etc.) vary widely.
No evidence in the packet explains why the globals are 8 bytes apart (0x5BF8CC vs 0x5BF8D4).
